title: Glowing mobile phone
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#aeeeff' stop-opacity='0.8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#aeeeff' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='screenGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#5ddcff'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#3ab8e8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2a8fc4'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Outer glow halo -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='42' ry='44' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- Phone body -->
  <rect x='28' y='10' width='44' height='78' rx='8' ry='8' fill='#4a7a99'/>
  <rect x='30' y='12' width='40' height='74' rx='6' ry='6' fill='#366178'/>

  <!-- Screen area -->
  <rect x='34' y='20' width='32' height='52' rx='3' ry='3' fill='url(#screenGrad)'/>

  <!-- Screen glow sheen -->
  <rect x='34' y='20' width='32' height='26' rx='3' ry='3' fill='#8af0ff' opacity='0.35'/>

  <!-- Screen content: simple app icons -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='32' r='4' fill='#ffdd57'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='32' r='4' fill='#ff7a9e'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='46' r='4' fill='#8cff9e'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='46' r='4' fill='#c49bff'/>

  <!-- Home button -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='80' r='4' fill='#6a9bb8'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='80' r='2.5' fill='#8ac4dd'/>

  <!-- Speaker slot -->
  <rect x='44' y='14' width='12' height='2' rx='1' fill='#5a8aa8'/>

  <!-- Cute light reflection dots on screen -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='24' r='1.5' fill='#bff4ff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='68' r='1' fill='#bff4ff' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
